summary: Completed targeted frontend+backend regression for C6 monthly canonical dynamic values. Frontend validateEditSubmission and backend EmissionRecordCreate both correctly enforce calendar-month day limits for qty_days_travelled, nights_stayed, and qty_nights alias scenarios.
action_items: No functional bug found in the requested C6 monthly canonical-value validation paths.
If desired, keep these two new targeted tests in regression runs to prevent future NaN bypass reintroduction.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend fix is present at Scope3FlatEdit.js: raw object values are unwrapped via rawValue.value before Number.parseFloat, preventing NaN skip on canonical object-shaped dynamic values.
No APIs or flows were MOCKED in this run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend direct validator regression covered canonical object inputs for qty_days_travelled, nights_stayed, and qty_nights; tested April 2025 boundary (30 pass/31 fail) and February leap/non-leap boundaries (2024: 29 pass/30 fail, 2025: 28 pass/29 fail). Backend model validator mirrored same limits and passed all targeted assertions.
rca of the issue: Pre-fix failure mode: Number.parseFloat was applied to the canonical object itself (e.g., {value: 30092, unit: ''}), producing NaN. Since Number.isFinite(NaN) is false, the month-limit rejection branch was skipped, allowing invalid values. Current code now unwraps object-shaped values first (`rawValue && typeof rawValue === 'object' ? rawValue.value : rawValue`) and then parses, so over-limit values are correctly rejected.
